Title: Ishaan and the Family

Cast

1. Ishaan - 11 years, son
Look: yellow T-shirt, blue shorts
2. Meera - 8 years, daughter
Look: pink T-shirt, ponytail
3. Neeta - 34 years, mother
Look: green saree
4. Savitri - 75 years, grandmother
Look: white saree, glasses
5. Naira - 11 years, friend
Look: yellow frock, two plaits

Places

1. The kitchen - a gas stove, steel pots
2. The park - green grass, swings, benches

Scene 1: The kitchen - Day

[Ishaan stands in the kitchen. Neeta stands near him.]

Ishaan: "Let's do something fun today."

[Ishaan makes tea for everyone.]

Ishaan (laughing): "What next?"

[Ishaan chops onions for the curry.]

Ishaan: "I'm ready!"

[Ishaan washes the dishes after dinner.]

Ishaan: "Show me too!"

Scene 2: The park - Day

[Ishaan stands in the park. Meera and Neeta stand near him.]

Neeta: "So, here we are!"

[Ishaan does push-ups.]

Neeta: "Ishaan, look at this."

[Ishaan does yoga on a mat.]

Ishaan: "Hmm, I see."

[Meera skips rope.]

Meera: "What a day to remember!"
